$comment: Content evaluations for proappstore-data-migrations-actions (#175). test/skills-data.evals.test.ts checks, per scenario, that the worked example exists, the anti-pattern it remediates is in anti-patterns.md with detect/clause/remediate/prove, the cited clauses exist and are active in docs/standard/standard.json and are linked at their published URL, every SDK surface named exists in packages/sdk/src, every manifest key is one the platform understands, unsupported needs are named in unsupported-requirements.md, and rejected substitutes are listed as 'do not use'.
